en: Attached to this lecture, you can find a
demo dataset. It's not the Microsoft dataset
we used in the last lecture. This is a dummy
dataset with dummy data to demonstrate in a
bit more detail what ChatGPT can do when it
comes to data preparation and data analysis.
This is a
sales file about different customers, sales
channels, regions, about the unit price and
the unit cost and the discount that was
applied. And I don't want to dive into this
sheet right now because I want to let
ChatGPT do the work. So as a first step, I
want to upload this file to ChatGPT and it
should tell me what this file is all about.
So first, in a new chat, I'll add photos and
files. In my case, it is a file.
Here we'll select the dummy dataset. And now
I'll add a first prompt here. Give me a
quick overview of this dataset, explain what
the columns contain and what kinds of
business questions we could answer with this
data. So if you didn't check the data, this
should be enough to understand what this
dataset is all about. And here we have the
analysis. So we have sales order rows of
this fictional company here.
And here we get an analysis of the
individual columns, what they contain and
what it is used for. We can see that we are
lacking
revenue data or profit columns, but these
can be calculated. Also something we'll find
out in the next lectures. It also identified
business questions we could answer so we can
dive deeper into this dataset. And then we
have the data cleaning opportunities.
